import re

def parse_section(text, marker):
    part=text.split(marker,1)[1]
    rows=[]
    for line in part.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',s) and s and len(s.split())==28:
            rows.append([int(v) for v in s.split()])
            if len(rows)==28: break
    assert len(rows)==28, len(rows)
    return rows
